WBK-1-080.effectEn: Choose 1 character in your opponent's Front Line with BP 3000 or less, retire it. If you have <桜 遥> on your field, it becomes “BP 5000 or less” instead.
WBK-1-080.triggerJp: 【スペシャル】相手のフロントLのキャラを1枚選び、退場させる。
